rationale: The agent executed a write action (modifying order #W5061109) without first confirming the change with the user, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. There is also no explicit authentication step shown before acting, and the message includes details (refund amount, payment method, product specs, and a restriction that no further modifications can be made) that are not supported by visible tool results. Even if the change itself aligns with the user’s request, the lack of confirmation and unclear authentication mean the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
